Specifically, firstly, it is found that inhibition or silencing of the LTA4H gene/protein can inhibit the replication of the foot-and-mouth disease virus, and the LTA4H gene/protein can serve as a target spot to be used for screening drugs for inhibiting the replication of the foot-and-mouth disease virus; (2) sgRNA targeting LTA4H is involved with LTA4H as a target spot, complete knockout of LTA4H is realized in PK-15 cells in combination with CRISPR-Cas9 technology, the obtained cell line has resistance phenotype to foot and mouth disease virus, certain theoretical basis is provided for prevention or inhibition of FMDV infection in the future, and the application prospect is wide.(ZH) 本发明属于基因工程技术领域，具体涉及一种LTA4H基因/蛋白为靶点在筛选抑制口蹄疫病毒复制的药物中的应用。具体为：①本发明首先发现抑制或沉默LTA4H基因/蛋白能够抑制口蹄疫病毒的复制，可作为靶点用于筛选抑制口蹄疫病毒复制的药物；②以LTA4H为靶点的涉及了靶向LTA4H的sgRNA，结合CRISPR‑Cas9技术在PK‑15细胞中实现了LTA4H的完全敲除，获得的细胞系对口蹄疫病毒具有抗性表型，对未来预防或抑制FMDV感染提供一些理论依据，具有广阔的应用前景。",,,,,,

View less classifications","UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING北京科技大学BEIJING ZHONGZHI BIO-AGRICULTURE INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE北京中智生物农业国际研究院BEIJING SHOU JIA LI HUA SCI-TECH CO., LTD.北京首佳利华科技有限公司",WAN XIANGYUAN万向元YAN TINGWEI颜廷玮AN XUELI安学丽JIANG YILIN江易林LIU XINZE刘欣泽ZHU TAOTAO朱涛涛LI ZIWEN李紫文DONG ZHENYING董振营WU SUOWEI吴锁伟LI JINPING李金萍,,(EN) Male sterility gene ZmMYB84 and application of male sterility gene ZmMYB84 in creation of male sterility line of maize(ZH) 雄性不育基因ZmMYB84及其在创制玉米雄性不育系中的应用,,"(EN) The invention discloses a male sterility gene ZmMYB84 and application of male sterility gene ZmMYB84 in creation of a male sterility line of maize. The male sterility gene ZmMYB84 has a nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.1, and the protein coded by the gene has an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.2. Complete male sterility can be caused by site-directed mutagenesis of the gene in wild type corn through a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, and the regulation function of the ZmMYB84 gene on male reproductive development of the corn is found. Through offspring screening, a sterile line without transgenic components can be obtained, a stable maize male sterile line is created, and the gene has important significance on maize male fertility control and hybrid seed production. A functional molecular marker is designed for the obtained myb84 male sterile mutant, and has important application value in maize male sterile line cultivation, sterile hybrid seed production and molecular marker-assisted selection.(ZH) 本发明公开了雄性不育基因ZmMYB84及其在创制玉米雄性不育系中的应用，具有SEQ ID NO.1所示的核苷酸序列，该基因编码的蛋白质具有SEQ ID NO.2所示的氨基酸序列。本发明通过CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术在野生型玉米中定点突变该基因，可以导致完全的雄性不育，发现了ZmMYB84基因对玉米雄性生殖发育的调控功能。通过后代筛选，可以得到不含转基因成分的不育系，创制出稳定的玉米雄性不育系，对玉米雄性育性控制和杂交种子生产具有重要意义。本发明还针对获得的myb84雄性不育突变体设计了功能分子标记，在玉米雄性不育系培育、不育化杂交制种和分子标记辅助选择中具有重要的应用价值。",113005128,30.06.2023,"C07K 14/415

View less classifications","LANZHOU VETERINARY RESEARCH INSTITUTE, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE SCIENCES中国农业科学院兰州兽医研究所",ZHENG HAIXUE郑海学ZHU ZIXIANG朱紫祥ZHANG XIANGLE张向乐CAO WEIJUN曹伟军YANG FAN杨帆TANG WENDA唐闻达LI PAN李攀QI XIAOLAN齐晓兰GU FENGXING顾峰幸CHEN WENZHE陈文哲ZHANG KESHAN张克山LIU XIANGTAO刘湘涛,北京力量专利代理事务所(特殊普通合伙) 11504,(EN) Construction of RIPLET knockout cell line and application of RIPLET knockout cell line as picornaviridae virus vaccine production cell line(ZH) RIPLET敲除细胞系的构建及作为小核糖核酸病毒科病毒疫苗生产细胞系的应用,,"(EN) The invention belongs to the field of gene engineering, and particularly relates to construction of an RIPLET knockout cell line and application of the RIPLET knockout cell line as a picornaviridae virus vaccine production cell line. Firstly, it is found that inhibition of RIPLET gene expression in host cells can promote replication of picornaviridae viruses, especially foot and mouth disease viruses and Seneca viruses. Secondly, the invention provides sgRNA specifically targeting RIPLET. The sgRNA can specifically target the RIPLET gene, the knockout of the RIPLET gene is realized by combining a CRISPR-Cas9 technology, and an obtained monoclonal cell line can significantly promote the replication of picornaviridae viruses, especially foot-and-mouth disease viruses and Seneca viruses. The production quantity and the antigen expression quantity of picornaviridae virus vaccines are improved, and the cell line can be used as a picornaviridae virus vaccine production cell line and has a wide application prospect.(ZH) 本发明属于基因工程领域，具体涉及RIPLET敲除细胞系的构建及作为小核糖核酸病毒科病毒疫苗生产细胞系的应用。本发明首先发现，抑制宿主细胞中RIPLET基因表达能促进小核糖核酸病毒科病毒，尤其是口蹄疫病毒和塞内卡病毒的复制；其次，本发明提供了一种特异性靶向RIPLET的sgRNA，所述sgRNA能够特异性靶向RIPLET基因，结合CRISPR‑Cas9技术实现了RIPLET基因的敲除，获得的单克隆细胞系能够显著促进小核糖核酸病毒科病毒，尤其是口蹄疫病毒和塞内卡病毒的复制，提高小核糖核酸病毒科病毒疫苗的生产量和抗原表达量，可作为小核糖核酸病毒科病毒疫苗的生产细胞系，具有广阔的应用前景。",114058619,14.11.2023,"C12N 15/1137

Firstly, the overexpression host EIF2B4 gene is found to be capable of inhibiting the replication of the FMDV, and can be used as a target spot for designing and screening drugs for inhibiting the replication of the FMDV; secondly, the host cell obtained by inhibiting or silencing the host EIF2B4 gene can promote the replication of the FMDV virus, and can be used as a production cell line of the FMDV virus or a virus vaccine; on the basis, the sgRNA specifically targeting the EIF2B4 gene is designed, the knockout of the EIF2B4 gene is realized by combining a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, the obtained monoclonal cell line can remarkably promote the replication of FMDV in cells, a tool and a material are provided for researching the molecular mechanism of the EIF2B4 gene, and the method has a wide prospect.(ZH) 本发明属于基因工程领域，具体涉及EIF2B4敲除细胞系的构建及作为小RNA病毒科病毒疫苗生产细胞系的应用。首先，本发明发现过表达宿主EIF2B4基因，能够抑制FMDV的复制，可作为靶点用于设计和筛选抑制FMDV复制的药物；其次，抑制或沉默宿主EIF2B4基因获得的宿主细胞能够促进FMDV病毒的复制，可作为FMDV病毒或病毒疫苗的生产细胞系；基于此，本发明设计了一种特异性靶向EIF2B4基因基因的sgRNA，结合CRISPR/Cas9技术实现了EIF2B4基因的敲除，获得的单克隆细胞系能够显著促进FMDV在细胞内的复制，为研究EIF2B4基因的分子机制提供了工具和材料，具有广阔的前景。",,,"C07K 14/4702

The related gene influencing tobacco plastid pigment synthesis is derived from tobacco and is named as pectate-like lyase (SPL), and the nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO.1. The CRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector for knocking out the pectate-like lyase gene is constructed by virtue of a CRISPR/Cas9-spl mediated gene editing technology, a Honghua Dajinyuan plant in which the pectate-like lyase gene is subjected to insertion mutation is obtained after genetic transformation, and the contents of neoxanthine, xanthophyll, chlorophyll b and chlorophyll a in 423 leaves of the obtained editing plant are remarkably increased, so that the content of the CCRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector is remarkably increased, and the content of the CCRISPR/Cas9-spl editing vector is remarkably increased. The knockout of the gene can influence the plastid pigment content of the plant leaf, so that a genetic material and a theoretical basis are provided for tobacco plastid pigment synthesis pathway research, tobacco leaf quality improvement and tobacco variety genetic improvement.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种影响烟草质体色素合成相关的基因及应用。该影响烟草质体色素合成相关的基因来源于烟草，命名为类果胶裂解酶(SPL)，其核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1所示。本发明通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的基因编辑技术，构建了用于敲除类果胶裂解酶基因的CRISPR/Cas9‑spl编辑载体，经遗传转化后获得了类果胶裂解酶基因发生插入突变的红花大金元植株，所获编辑植株423叶片中的新黄质、叶黄素、叶绿素b、叶绿素a含量显著增加，表明该基因的敲除可影响植株叶片质体色素含量，这为烟草质体色素合成通路研究，烟叶品质改善、烟草品种遗传改良提供遗传材料和理论依据。",,,,,,

View less classifications",GUIZHOU RICE RESEARCH INSTITUTE贵州省水稻研究所,PENG QIANG彭强LI JIALI李佳丽ZHANG DASHUANG张大双WU XIAN吴娴ZHU SUSONG朱速松,贵阳易博皓专利代理事务所(普通合伙) 52116,(EN) Breeding method for improving disease resistance of rice against rice blast(ZH) 一种水稻稻瘟病抗性改良的育种方法,,"(EN) The invention discloses a breeding method for improvingdisease resistance of rice against rice blast. The method comprises the following steps: selecting broad-spectrum resistance genes Pi21 and Pid3that produce resistance due to function deletion; selecting gene editing sites of the genes Pi21 and Pid3, amplifying a U3 or U6 RNA promoter of the disease-resistant gene to construct a CRISPR/Cas9 vector; introducing the CRISPR/Cas9 vector into a callus, and carrying out resistance screening and differentiation culture to obtain a T0-generation transgenic plant; detecting whether a detected offspring plant of the T0-generation transgenic plant contains Cas9 exogenous DNA or not; screening a mutant strain with knockout of functional genes, amplifying target site DNA of the mutant strain, carrying out TA cloning sequencing to obtain DNA mutation information; and screening an improved strain that does not contain Cas9 exogenous DNA and has homozygous mutation on the disease-resistant gene Pi21 or Pid3 from offsprings. The breeding method of the present invention solves the problem that new varieties of rice obtained by a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology in related technologies is still damaged by rice blast, and improves disease resistance of the rice against rice blast.(ZH) 本申请公开了一种水稻稻瘟病抗性改良的育种方法，该方法包括：选择功能缺失产生抗性的广谱抗性基因Pi21和Pid3；选择基因Pi21和Pid3的基因编辑位点，并扩增抗病基因的U3或U6 RNA启动子，构建CRISPR/Cas9载体；将CRISPR/Cas9载体导入愈伤组织，通过抗性筛选和分化培养得到T0代转基因植株；检测所述T0代转基因植株的检测子代植株是否含有Cas9外源DNA；筛选功能基因敲除的突变株系，并且扩增突变株系的靶位点DNA，TA克隆测序得到DNA突变信息；在后代中筛选不含Cas9外源DNA的，并且抗病基因Pi21或Pid3发生纯合突变的改良株系。通过本申请解决相关技术中通过CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术得到的新品种仍然会受到稻瘟病的侵害的问题，提高了水稻对稻瘟病的抗病性。",,,"C12N 15/8282

View less classifications","LANZHOU VETERINARY RESEARCH INSTITUTE, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE SCIENCES中国农业科学院兰州兽医研究所",ZHENG HAIXUE郑海学ZHANG WEI张伟YANG FAN杨帆YANG YANG杨洋QI XIAOLAN齐晓兰ZHU ZIXIANG朱紫祥CAO WEIJUN曹伟军REN RUIFANG任蕊芳ZHENG MIN郑敏ZHANG KESHAN张克山,北京力量专利代理事务所(特殊普通合伙) 11504,(EN) Application of KIF5B gene as target spot in inhibition of replication of the foot-and-mouth disease virus(ZH) KIF5B基因作为靶点在抑制口蹄疫病毒复制中的应用,,"(EN) Firstly, the invention discovers that through inhibition or silencing a host KIF5B gene, the replication of a foot-and-mouth disease virus can be inhibited, and the host KIF5B gene can be used as a target spot for preparing or screening medicines for inhibiting the replication of the foot-and-mouth disease virus; and secondly, the KIF5B is taken as the target spot, siRNA is designed, and the siRNA can inhibit the replication of the foot and mouth disease virus and can be used for preparing the medicines for inhibiting the replication of the foot and mouth disease virus. View less classifications",ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY浙江大学,DU HAO都浩YUAN YUE袁月CHEN WENZHEN陈文臻TU JUMIN凃巨民,杭州天勤知识产权代理有限公司 33224,(EN) Application of rice OsS6K1 gene or OsS6K2 gene in improving rice yield and/or drought resistance(ZH) 水稻OsS6K1基因或OsS6K2基因在提高水稻产量和/或抗旱性中的应用,,"(EN) The invention discloses application of a rice OsS6K1 gene or an OsS6K2 gene homologous with the rice OsS6K1 gene in improving rice yield and/or drought resistance, and belongs to the technical field of biology.
